% 16.11.2023 1. None is appearing for the respondent nos.1 to 3, that is, the Claimants, and the respondent nos.4 and 5, that is, the driver and the owner of the offending vehicle.

2. The following important question of law arises for consideration of this court:
"Where the insurance company raises a defence under Section 150 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 which may allow it to claim a right to recover the compensation paid from the owner of the offending vehicle, and where the owner of the offending vehicle fails to file the written statement, whether the Tribunal can insist on the insurance company to file its legal offer in terms of the Scheme for Motor Accident Claims formulated by the Delhi High Court in its judgement in Rajesh Tyagi v. Jaibir Singh, 2021 SCC OnLine Del 4046. "
